title_sq: Tek Univers City, Shitet Njesi Biznesi, Ideale Per Veprimtari Te Ndryshme Biznesi!!!
description_sq: Tek Univers City, Shitet Njesi Biznesi, Ideale Per Veprimtari Te Ndryshme Biznesi!!! Prona ndodhet ne katin 0, si dhe ka nje siperfaqe bruto prej 38.9 m2, nga ku siperfaqja neto eshte 33.9 m2. Organizohet nga nje ambient open-space dhe tualeti. Aktualisht godina ne te cilen ndodhet ambienti eshte ne faze suvatimesh dhe pritet te dorezohet ne fillim te vitit tjeter.
title_en: At Univers City, a business unit is for sale, ideal for various business activities!!!
description_en: At Univers City, a business unit is for sale, ideal for various business activities!!! The property is located on the 0th floor, and has a gross area of ​​38.9 m2, from which the net area is 33.9 m2. It is organized by an open-space environment and toilet. The front part has a glass facade, which enables the advertising of the business activity you want to develop. The orientation of the property is east. Currently, the building in which the environment is located is in the stage of plastering and is expected to be delivered at the beginning of next year.
